name: base
purpose: reset at power-up with a sig rise inside it and a release while sig is high (no qualification); a plain 12 ns qualification and a falling clear; a glitch burst whose cancelled qualifications end while sig is high again (stale completions at 77.02 and 85.02 ns must not fire); reset while the output is high and a release with sig high; a 2 ns reset pulse inside a qualification; falls 0.325 ns before and 0.325 ns after a completion, the 0.3 ns minimum plus one 25 ps grid step (the second interrupts the rising output)
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vsig (sig 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 4.97n 0 5.07n 0.9 29.97n 0.9 30.07n 0 34.97n 0 35.07n 0.9 59.97n 0.9 60.07n 0 64.97n 0 65.07n 0.9 69.97n 0.9 70.07n 0 72.97n 0 73.07n 0.9 73.695n 0.9 73.795n 0 74.22n 0 74.32n 0.9 114.97n 0.9 115.07n 0 119.97n 0 120.07n 0.9 144.97n 0.9 145.07n 0 149.97n 0 150.07n 0.9 161.645n 0.9 161.745n 0 164.97n 0 165.07n 0.9 177.295n 0.9 177.395n 0 179.97n 0 180.07n 0.9 200n 0.9]
Vrst (rst_n 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 9.97n 0 10.07n 0.9 94.97n 0.9 95.07n 0 97.97n 0 98.07n 0.9 124.97n 0.9 125.07n 0 126.97n 0 127.07n 0.9 200n 0.9]

XDUT (sig rst_n out) debounce_latch

simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-8 iabstol=1e-12
tran tran stop=200n maxstep=25p strobeperiod=25p errpreset=moderate strobeoutput=strobeonly
save sig rst_n out
